fileTitle: File:Sentinel U.S. Army Specialist Jessica Kwiatkowski conducts her last Changing of the Guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery, Virginia, October 4, 2024 - 35.jpg
creator: Arlington National Cemetery
alt: Jessica Kwiatkowski during an archive Tomb Guard ceremony in October 2024
description: U.S. Army Spc. Jessica Kwiatkowski conducts her last walk ceremony at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier at Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, Virginia, Oct. 4, 2024. Placing a rose at the foot of each crypt signifies a Sentinels' last and final honor before they leave the tomb. (U.S. Army photo by Elizabeth Fraser / Arlington National Cemetery / released)
caption: Archive: Specialist Jessica Kwiatkowski during her final-walk ceremony in October 2024. She is not Thomas Iglesias; this illustrates the sentinel role only.
